messages:
Maya L.: Quick planning thread — want to finalize DP recruitment + pledge phrasing. Proposal: 10-day pledge window, tiered incentives (credit + feature preview), 3 mandatory touchpoints, and explicit handoff artifacts. feedback?

Jin W.: 10 days ok. recommend soft RSVP then a 5-day confirm window to avoid ghosting. incentive tiers sound smart (higher commit = higher credit). :white_check_mark:

Maya L.: Good point re: two-stage RSVP. update: Stage 1 = interest (open invite). Stage 2 = confirm pledge (5 days). Pledge requires commit to onboarding + two feedback sessions.

Carlos P.: Cohort mix: we should ensure at least 3 verticals (search, embeddings, agent flows). target 20 confirmed pledges per cohort to get ~10 active. also include at least 2 enterprise-grade customers for infra signals.

Asha N.: On feedback tooling: suggest single weekly form (5 quick Qs) + short asynchronous interview (15m) post-run. also need templated issue CSV and a single shared Figma board for UX notes.

Maya L.: Draft deliverables list:
- weekly pulse (automated survey)
- issue tracker CSV export
- session transcripts/highlights
- customer-runbook + integration notes

Jin W.: Measurement: define "engaged" = used API > 200 tokens or >2 sessions in a week. activation gate = 50% of confirmed pledges meeting engaged by week 2. Exit if <25% by week 4 and we documented reasons.

Carlos P.: Legal asks: simple NDA opt-in checkbox during pledge confirm. retention clause: demo data retained 90 days unless customer opts out. I'll loop in legal for a one-paragraph clause.

dp-bot: Notice: `Pledge confirm window opens in 2 days` — scheduled post. :calendar:

Asha N.: Ops note: require a smoke test during onboarding — ingest sample payload and verify latency within customer SLA. flag infra blockers early.

Maya L.: Hand-off flow to product: dp-bot weekly posts pulse summary + top-3 issues to #product-dp-reviews. Product to review within 3 business days and prioritize triage.

Jin W.: Next steps: Maya to finalize invite copy, Carlos to get legal blurb by Thu, Asha to create survey template, Jin to publish engagement metric definitions. Plan to open interest form next Mon.

Carlos P.: ack, will ping legal.

Asha N.: will share survey + figma board link when ready.

Maya L.: Thanks — aim to close first confirm window in two weeks. flag blockers now. :rocket:
